title: Nonogram: how to play
sections: Find the hidden picture: fill exactly the right squares of the grid.

The numbers next to each row (and above each column) are the lengths of the groups of filled squares in that line, in order. '3 1' means: a group of 3 filled squares, at least one empty square, then a single filled square. A 0 means the whole line is empty.

Tap a square to fill it, tap again to clear it. Long-press, or switch on Cross mode, to mark a square you know is empty with an X. Drag along a row or column to fill (or cross) many squares at once. Hint fills in one correct square; Undo takes back a move.

Start with lines whose numbers almost fill them: in a 5-wide row, a 4 always covers the middle 3 squares. Cross out squares you know are empty, they make the other lines easier. A line is done when its groups match its numbers.
Easy: 5 x 5. Normal: 8 x 8. Hard: 10 x 10. You score more for bigger grids and quick wins; every hint costs points.
